Do you have 2-5 years of experience in Governance, Risk & Compliance and want to help organizations identify and manage business and IT risks? As a Risk Consultant at Securance Advisory, you will work on varied projects across different sectors, combining process optimization, IT risk management, compliance and internal control.

Tasks
• Advise clients on governance and policy across business and IT.

• Design, implement, analyze, document, visualize and optimize processes.

• Set up and implement frameworks such as ISAE, COBIT and ISO 27001.

• Perform compliance scans related to regulations such as DORA, NIS2 and GDPR.

• Perform risk analyses and design and test controls.

• Conduct internal audits and support external audits.

• Prepare reports and advise clients using practical best practices.

• Deliver internal and external training.

• Contribute internally by developing propositions, improving processes and sharing knowledge.

Requirements
• Completed HBO/WO (Bachelor's or Master's) degree, preferably Business- or IT-related.

• 2-5 years of relevant experience in GRC, risk management, compliance, security, process management or a related field.

• Strong communication skills, a proactive hands-on mindset and the ability to work independently and in teams.

• Commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build strong client relationships.

• Knowledge of GITCs, COSO, COBIT, SOC, ISAE, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, ISO 27001 or related frameworks is a plus.

• Certifications such as CC, CISM, CRISC, CISSP or CIPP are a plus.

• Affinity with the financial sector is a plus.

• Professional proficiency in English; Dutch language skills are preferred.

Benefits
• €3,200-€5,600 gross per month, depending on experience, excluding holiday allowance.

• Attractive bonus scheme comparable to a 13th month.

• Company laptop and phone allowance.

• Mobility budget for public transport or a lease car.
